revision_summary: Two wrong_ts quote errors must be corrected in script_coverage[11] ('appointment_set'): the rep line 'So the phone call would be just forty minutes long...' is actually at ~02:53-02:59, not 00:33; the customer line 'I can't do it on Tuesday...' is actually at ~01:55-01:58, not 00:33. Both should be re-timestamped and the entry's ts/end_ts range corrected to span the real appointment-negotiation window (roughly 00:29 through 02:59) rather than anchoring the whole beat to 00:33. Additionally: (1) correct the schema citation in cherry_pick_moments for the 02:08 'scheduler/computer' moment — bill_collection.alternative_paths does not apply to a scheduling-logistics breakdown; either recite button_up.appointment_datetime_confirmed or flag as an uncovered schema gap. (2) Sharpen the reasoning in observed_outcome and cherry_pick_moments[3] (02:40) to reflect that the customer's 3PM callback window (02:27) chronologically PRECEDES the rep's vague callback/text offer (02:40) — the rep had already heard the specific window and still failed to lock it, which is a more damning sequential-miss framing than Stage 3's current 'separately mentioned' language suggests. (3) Consider re-ordering or annotating cherry_pick_moments so the 02:27 customer-anchor moment is presented before the 02:40 rep-response moment to avoid confusing non-chronological sequencing for the reader. Outcome dispute and reactive/strategic calls are otherwise well-supported; no fabricated coaching language or tone issues found.
